capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Porsche US and Canada: gross energy capacity 113 kWh (Cayenne S release; HV battery press kit says the same).

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: InsideEVs lists 108 kWh usable for Cayenne and Cayenne Turbo; batterydesign.net says about 108. Porsche pages opened give gross only. Same pack assumed for S and Coupe bodies (Porsche: 113 kWh in the S release).

chemistry.notes: Porsche: nickel-manganese-cobalt-aluminium (NMCA) cathode, 86% nickel; closest schema value nmc (no NMCA enum).

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: Porsche says the Cayenne Electric has "predictive thermal management" for charging and the same Charging Planner family as the Macan Electric (Porsche US planner page lists Taycan and Macan Electric, not Cayenne). Lineup-wide feature assumed.

dc_max_kw.notes: Porsche: up to 400 kW (390 kW under optimal conditions, 850 V / 520 A charger).

published_10_80_min.notes: Porsche: "less than 16 minutes" 10-80% under optimal conditions (390 kW NACS station, 60 F battery).

ac_max_kw.notes: Estimated: Porsche (UK support page and global press kit) states the standard Cayenne Electric on-board charger as up to 11 kW (22 kW optional). No North American Porsche, Monroney or tester page stating the US/Canada standard was found: one US dealer listing (not opened) also says 11 kW standard / 19.2 kW optional, while Consumer Reports (snippet only) says 9.6 kW. Needs an owner/Monroney check for North America.
